CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.exam_x35e11.m1_top_zips AS
WITH trips_filtered AS (
  SELECT pickup_zip,
         fare_amount,
         hour(tpep_pickup_datetime) AS pickup_hour
  FROM samples.nyctaxi.trips
  WHERE pickup_zip IS NOT NULL
),
zip_stats AS (
  SELECT pickup_zip,
         COUNT(*) AS trips,
         SUM(fare_amount) AS total_fare
  FROM trips_filtered
  GROUP BY pickup_zip
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 200
),
busiest_hour AS (
  SELECT pickup_zip, hour AS busiest_hour
  FROM (
    SELECT pickup_zip,
           pickup_hour AS hour,
           COUNT(*) AS cnt,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pickup_zip ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, pickup_hour ASC) AS rn
    FROM trips_filtered
    GROUP BY pickup_zip, pickup_hour
  ) t
  WHERE rn = 1
),
combined AS (
  SELECT z.pickup_zip,
         z.trips,
         ROUND(z.total_fare, 2) AS total_fare,
         bh.busiest_hour
  FROM zip_stats z
  JOIN busiest_hour bh USING (pickup_zip)
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_fare DESC) AS fare_rank,
         ROUND(
           SUM(total_fare) OVER (ORDER BY total_fare DESC, pickup_zip ASC
                                 ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
           / (SELECT SUM(total_fare) FROM combined) * 100, 2) AS cumulative_share_pct
  FROM combined
)
SELECT pickup_zip, trips, total_fare, fare_rank, cumulative_share_pct, busiest_hour
FROM ranked
WHERE fare_rank <= 10
ORDER BY fare_rank;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM workspace.exam_x35e11.m1_top_zips;
